architecture: Residual Conv1D encoder 1-16-32-64 (kernel 9, stride 2), bottleneck 64-64 (kernel 7, dilation 4), transpose-convolution decoder 64-32-16-1 (kernel 8, stride 2); GELU; no batch normalization
scale: One RMS scalar from current fold training EEG only; reversible internal scaling, output remains in microvolts
loss: MSE against paired clean reference, divided by training scale squared (constant per fold)
training_noise: One of nine Noise v2 conditions sampled uniformly per training epoch sample; independent deterministic training seed for each fold and epoch; no extra clean training cases
validation_noise: Original Noise v2 fixed seed 123 and filename:epoch IDs; Clean plus nine noisy conditions
selection: Highest equally weighted validation Macro-F1 across ten conditions after frozen AttnSleep; earliest epoch wins exact ties
early_stopping: Stop after 6 epochs without validation improvement, at least 5 epochs; maximum 30
test: Only after all five DAE selections are frozen; CPU inference with original baseline batch size; original Noise v2
scope: One prespecified architecture and optimizer configuration; no test-driven tuning
